# giovanes.dev

> Personal website of Giovane Saes — Product & AI Engineer based in São Paulo, Brazil.

## About

This site serves three distinct audiences:

1. **Engineers & Tech People** — A blog with technical posts about software engineering, AI, and building products.
2. **Recruiters** — A professional portfolio showcasing experience, projects, and technologies.
3. **Wanderers** — A typing roguelike game called "Type to Survive."
